hero.purpose: Landing page only. Never appears inside a room.

count.purpose: The big number in the count block; the most-read element in the product.

title.purpose: Room title (single line, ellipsis) and panel headings.

place.purpose: Sticker and place names; the word on the Add button.

body.purpose: Brief rows, composer input, panel prose. Semibold because the ground is warm and dense.

label.purpose: Subtitles, chip labels, uppercase section heads like WHAT MATTERS.

numeral.purpose: Mono, tabular. Count subline, row deltas, badge numerals, every line in the { } drawer.

shadows.name: drop
shadows.purpose: Resting elements: brief rows, stickers, pills, viewing badges.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Composer bar, scope menu, calmer count block states.

shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Count block and the selected sticker. The loudest thing on the map.

shadows.name: semantic-drop
shadows.purpose: A row whose border is semantic promotes its shadow to the same colour. Never colour one without the other.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The only easing curve in the system.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: A place enters or leaves the candidate set. Leavers fade in place, returners grow from their dot. Never a re-layout.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: The selected sticker's idle breath (scale 1 to 1.035).

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: A place that would come back if a need were relaxed (opacity .72 to 1).

motion.name: busy
motion.purpose: A dashed ring turning around whatever is being looked up. Rotation only, on an inner element.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion zeroes all four. Busy then stands as a still dashed ring beside its text, never nothing.

components.name: Composer Bar
components.description: The single input surface of the room: scope chosen before speaking, then the word Add. The bar owns the border, radius and shadow; the field owns nothing.
components.html: Shared
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; align-items: stretch; border: 1.5px solid var(--spoke-works, #2c6b52); border-radius: 13px; background: var(--spoke-surface, #fffdf7); box-shadow: 2px 3px 0 rgba(51,65,54,.30); overflow: hidden; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-scope-chip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; margin: 0 9px 0 10px; align-self: center; border: 1.5px solid var(--spoke-works, #2c6b52); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--spoke-works-tint, #dfeee6); color: var(--spoke-works-text, #1e5540); padding: 4px 8px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-caret { width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 3.5px solid transparent; border-right: 3.5px solid transparent; border-top: 4.5px solid currentColor; } .ds-composer-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: none; background: none; font: 600 13px system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--spoke-ink, #334136); padding: 14px 0; min-height: 44px; } .ds-composer-input:focus { outline: none; } .ds-composer-input::placeholder { color: var(--spoke-ink-ghost, #8f8975); } .ds-add { flex: none; border: none; border-left: 1.5px solid var(--spoke-works, #2c6b52); background: var(--spoke-works, #2c6b52); color: var(--spoke-surface, #fffdf7); font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; padding: 0 15px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-add:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: default; } .ds-add:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spoke-ink, #334136); outline-offset: -4px; }

components.name: Scope Chip — private
components.description: The same chip after the speaker picks Private or Agent only. Violet is visibility; it never becomes green just because the need is active.
components.css: .ds-scope-private { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; border: 1.5px solid var(--spoke-scope, #7d6396); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--spoke-scope-tint, #ece5f2); color: var(--spoke-scope-text, #57436b); padding: 4px 8px; font: 700 10.5px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; position: relative; } .ds-scope-private::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -4px; right: -4px; top: 50%; height: 44px; transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-caret2 { width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 3.5px solid transparent; border-right: 3.5px solid transparent; border-top: 4.5px solid currentColor; }

components.name: Need Row
components.description: One stated need in the brief. Tap toggles; press and hold previews the set without it. Variants differ in border colour, border style, shadow colour and trailing mark, so they separate in greyscale.
components.css: .ds-need { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 9px; width: 100%; background: var(--spoke-surface, #fffdf7); border: 1.5px solid rgba(51,65,54,.55); border-radius: 13px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(51,65,54,.30); padding: 8px 10px; min-height: 44px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-need[data-variant="applied"] { border-color: var(--spoke-works, #2c6b52); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--spoke-works, #2c6b52); } .ds-need[data-variant="unsure"] { border-color: var(--spoke-unsure, #b05f2c); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--spoke-unsure, #b05f2c); } .ds-need[data-variant="private"] { border-color: var(--spoke-scope, #7d6396); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--spoke-scope, #7d6396); background: var(--spoke-scope-tint, #ece5f2); } .ds-need[data-variant="peer-private"] { border-style: dashed; box-shadow: none; background: transparent; cursor: default; } .ds-toggle { flex: none; width: 36px; height: 21px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--spoke-works, #2c6b52); position: relative; } .ds-toggle i { position: absolute; top: 2.5px; left: 17px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--spoke-surface, #fffdf7); } .ds-need-label { flex: 1; font: 600 13px system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--spoke-ink, #334136); } .ds-need-delta { font: 600 10px 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--spoke-ink-soft, #5b6158); } .ds-need:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spoke-ink, #334136); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Suggestion Pill
components.description: An optional facet the server returned for the current candidate set, ordered by count descending. Round, so it never reads as a stated need. ~24px tall with the tap target extended to 44px by a pseudo-element.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(51,65,54,.55); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--spoke-surface, #fffdf7); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(51,65,54,.30); padding: 5px 12px; font: 700 11.5px system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--spoke-ink, #334136); cursor: pointer; position: relative; } .ds-pill::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: 44px; transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-pill-count { font: 700 10px 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--spoke-ink-soft, #5b6158); } .ds-pill:hover { border-color: var(--spoke-works, #2c6b52); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spoke-ink, #334136); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Count Block
components.description: Top-left of the map, rotated -2 degrees, no pointer events. Confirmed plus likely in the big number; the subline breaks it down. Turns Unverified Amber at impasse.
components.html:
6still
work
of 34 · 4 of them likely · 3 unsure
components.css: .ds-count { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 13px; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 3px 4px 0 rgba(51,65,54,.30); transform: rotate(-2deg); background: var(--spoke-works, #2c6b52); color: var(--spoke-surface, #fffdf7); border: 1.5px solid var(--spoke-works, #2c6b52); } .ds-count[data-state="impasse"] { background: var(--spoke-unsure, #b05f2c); border-color: var(--spoke-unsure, #b05f2c); } .ds-count-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 7px; } .ds-count-number { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 30px; line-height: .85; letter-spacing: -.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-count-label { font: 700 11px system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.25; padding-bottom: 2px; } .ds-count-sub { font: 600 10px 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; line-height: 1.3; opacity: .85; margin-top: 4px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Map Sticker
components.description: A place that survives the active needs. The dot states the verdict, the card states the name. Ruled-out places lose the card entirely and become an 8px grey dot.
components.css: .ds-sticker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; background: var(--spoke-surface, #fffdf7); border: 1.5px solid rgba(51,65,54,.55); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(51,65,54,.30); padding: 5px 9px 5px 7px; white-space: nowrap; rotate: -2deg; } .ds-sticker-dot { width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; background: var(--spoke-works, #2c6b52); border: 1.5px solid rgba(51,65,54,.55); } .ds-sticker[data-state="unsure"] .ds-sticker-dot { background: var(--spoke-surface, #fffdf7); border: 2.5px solid var(--spoke-unsure, #b05f2c); } .ds-sticker[data-state="selected"] { background: var(--spoke-works, #2c6b52); box-shadow: 3px 4px 0 rgba(51,65,54,.30); } .ds-sticker[data-state="selected"] .ds-sticker-name { color: var(--spoke-surface, #fffdf7); } .ds-sticker-name { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--spoke-ink, #334136); } .ds-sticker-chip { font: 600 9.5px system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 5px; padding: 1px 5px; background: var(--spoke-works-tint, #dfeee6); color: var(--spoke-works-text, #1e5540); }

components.name: Scope Badge
components.description: Solid violet with cream text when the boundary is hard (agent only); the tinted variants carry the softer states. Sits beside, never instead of, an act mark when both meanings coincide.
components.html: agent only 3 unknown acting now
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font: 700 10px system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 6px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge[data-kind="scope"] { background: var(--spoke-scope, #7d6396); color: var(--spoke-surface, #fffdf7); } .ds-badge[data-kind="unsure"] { background: var(--spoke-unsure-tint, #f7e3d6); color: var(--spoke-unsure-text, #8a3f12); } .ds-badge[data-kind="act"] { background: var(--spoke-act-tint, #e1e7f0); color: var(--spoke-act-text, #2b4159); } .ds-badge[data-kind="works"] { background: var(--spoke-works-tint, #dfeee6); color: var(--spoke-works-text, #1e5540); }

components.name: Consent Card
components.description: Rung 2 of the authority ladder: an agent staged something beyond its grant. All three rungs are Moved Blue because in every case an agent moved. It cannot be dismissed by tapping outside.
components.html: Widen from 900 m to 1.4 km — beyond the 1.2 km you delegated. Your agent staged it; only this gesture applies it.
components.css: .ds-consent { border: 1.5px solid var(--spoke-act, #3d5a80); border-radius: 13px; background: var(--spoke-act-tint, #e1e7f0); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--spoke-act, #3d5a80); padding: 10px 12px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 320px; } .ds-consent-body { margin: 0 0 9px; font: 500 11.5px system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--spoke-act-text, #2b4159); } .ds-consent-actions { display: flex; gap: 7px; } .ds-consent-primary { border: 1.5px solid var(--spoke-act, #3d5a80); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--spoke-act, #3d5a80); color: var(--spoke-surface, #fffdf7); font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; padding: 9px 14px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-consent-ghost { border: 1.5px solid rgba(51,65,54,.35); border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: var(--spoke-ink-soft, #5b6158); font: 700 11px system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 9px 12px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-consent-primary:focus-visible, .ds-consent-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--spoke-ink, #334136); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Spokes is drawn the way a surveyor marks a working page: solid for what is known, dashed for what is guessed, hollow for what is unverified, and deliberately small and grey for what has been ruled out. Every visual property carries a fact. A border style is a claim about certainty. A dot's size is a claim about relevance. A colour is a claim about meaning, and there are exactly four meanings. Nothing in the system is decorative, because a decoration in a notebook is a mark somebody has to interpret.

The temperament is quiet and evidential. The interface recedes so the evidence reads: warm cream paper, ink-green text, flat spot colour, hard offset shadows with zero blur, and one 1.5px rule doing all the structural work. Nothing glows, floats, or gradients. Depth is a printed offset, not a light source. When the candidate set changes, places settle in place over 420ms; the page never re-lays-out under the reader, because spatial memory is what the product is protecting.

The system is built to be read in a narrow column beside a live conversation. Spokes is a WebMCP surface: it runs inside ChatGPT's in-app browser as the interactive visualization layer next to the transcript, driven by agent tool calls and direct touch alike. That means it must stay legible at ~330px, must never render a chat pane of its own, and must never look like a widget embedded in someone else's product. It reads as the map the conversation is about.
keyCharacteristics: Four semantic inks, one meaning each, never borrowed for emphasis.
Solid / dashed / hollow is an epistemic vocabulary, not a style choice.
Hard 2px offset shadows, zero blur, on a warm cream ground.
One 1.5px rule; a full-strength coloured border always means something.
Absolute counts in a display face, breakdowns in mono.
Slight rotation (-2 degrees, -4/3 degrees) so elements read as placed, not rendered.
Survives greyscale: fill, border style and size differ per state.

rules.name: The Four Meanings Rule
rules.body: Confirmed Green, Unverified Amber, Held-Back Violet and Moved Blue own one meaning each. A component may not borrow another's colour for emphasis. When two meanings genuinely coincide, draw both marks — a violet agent-only badge beside a blue acting-now chip.

rules.name: The No-Raw-Hex Rule
rules.body: Every colour comes from apps/web/src/tokens.css. If the value you need is not there, the design is missing a decision — ask, don't invent. The only literals outside that file are the documented GL paint pairs in src/map-theme.ts and the favicon data URI.

rules.name: The Composited Contrast Rule
rules.body: These surfaces stack translucent layers, so a new tint is checked against what it actually composites over — never against the token beneath it in the file. Body text holds 4.5:1 or better, composited.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Display names and counts; system sans explains. A heading in the body face is a mistake, and an explanation in the display face is a louder mistake.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any numeral that changes while the reader is looking at it is tabular-nums in mono or the display face. Counts must not jitter as the set settles.

rules.name: The Never Re-Centre Rule
rules.body: A change to the candidate set never re-fits bounds, re-centres, or re-lays-out the map. Places settle where they are. Only an explicit user action — search, show me, opening a place — or the explore layer following a panned viewport may move the view.

rules.name: The One Scroller Rule
rules.body: Only the brief scrolls. Header, map and composer are fixed. No nav bar, no tab bar, no hamburger: the room is the whole app.

rules.name: The Bottom-Left Rule
rules.body: The delta chip sits bottom-left at z-index 5, because bottom-right belongs to map attribution. Attribution stays 7px with a 9px line-height and never grows; it is a legal requirement, not a UI element.

rules.name: The Zero-Blur Rule
rules.body: Never use a blur greater than 0 for structure. If something needs to feel closer, it takes a longer offset, not a softer edge.

rules.name: The Coloured Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow in a semantic colour always means the row's border is that colour too. Never colour one without the other.

rules.name: The Marks-Not-Glyphs Rule
rules.body: No check, cross or bullet characters anywhere in chrome. A state is drawn with the map's dot vocabulary so the same shape means the same thing on the map and off it.

rules.name: The Meaningful Outline Rule
rules.body: The semantic border is the only full-strength line in the design; neutral rows use the tinted line. That is what makes an outline mean something.

dos: Do take every colour, radius, shadow and size from tokens.css, and ask when the value you need is missing.
Do draw certainty with border style: solid known, dashed guessed, hollow unverified, small grey ruled out.
Do promote a row's shadow to its semantic colour whenever its border is semantic, and leave both neutral otherwise.
Do extend tap targets past the drawn box with padding or ::before to reach 44px.
Do keep counts absolute and deltas signed — -19, +3, 34 to 15 — with the total on the second line.
Do let every control come from server data (FACETS.md), ordered by count descending.
Do check new tints against their composited background, not the token underneath.
Do design for ~330px first: the room runs inside ChatGPT's in-app browser beside a live transcript.
donts: Don't borrow one semantic colour for another's emphasis. Show both marks when two meanings coincide.
Don't use a blur greater than 0 for structure, or a gradient, glass, glow or sparkle anywhere.
Don't write a domain word, chip, icon, category or heading into chrome — the app is domain-agnostic permanently.
Don't render unknown as a red or negative state, and never silently drop a place for lacking a value.
Don't re-centre, re-fit or re-lay-out the map because the set changed.
Don't let anything protocol-shaped out of the { } drawer.
Don't use check, cross or bullet glyphs in chrome; use the map's dot vocabulary.
Don't add a fifth animation, a nav bar, a bottom sheet, or a chat pane — the transcript already exists in the host client.
Don't grow the map attribution above 7px, or move the delta chip to the bottom-right.
Don't drift toward SaaS dashboard chrome, consumer-maps chrome, or AI product chrome (gradient mesh, sparkles, purple-blue accents).
